schedule_bad_block.message: {day}: each period needs a start and an end time.

schedule_bad_day.message: Unknown day: {day}. Use monday to sunday.

schedule_need_full_week.message: The current schedule is unknown, so give all seven days.

schedule_unsupported_period.message: The current schedule contains periods other than comfort and eco, which this integration cannot write back. Change the whole week in the Watts app first.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedule of Watts thermostats. For each day (monday to sunday) it lists the comfort periods as blocks with start and end (HH:MM); all other times run at eco. Also returns the comfort and eco temperatures. The result has the same format that Set schedule accepts, so you can read a schedule, change it and send it back.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Changes the weekly schedule of Watts thermostats, as the Watts app does. Give the comfort periods for each day you want to change; days you leave out keep their current schedule. Times outside the periods run at eco. The thermostat follows the schedule in Auto mode. The change is checked by reading the schedule back, and a notification appears if it does not apply. Returns the previous and the new schedule.

monday.name: Monday
monday.description: Comfort periods for Monday, as a list of blocks with start and end times (HH:MM, quoted, in 15-minute steps; end "00:00" means midnight). All other times run at the eco temperature. An empty list makes the whole day eco. Leave the field out to keep the day as it is.
